items.source: Consider Whitespace and punctuation as base characters.
items.translation: 将空白字符和标点符号视为基础字符。

items.source:
Whitespace and punctuation are not considered base characters and are only distinguished at strength.
NOTE: Only works for Collation.ICUComparisonLevel above Collation.ComparisonLevel.tertiary().
items.translation:
空白字符和标点符号不被视为基本字符，仅在强度级别上进行区分。
注意： 此功能仅适用于 Collation.ICUComparisonLevel 高于 Collation.ComparisonLevel.tertiary() 的情况。

items.source: Whitespace and punctuation are not considered base characters and are only distinguished at strength.
items.translation: 空白字符和标点符号不被视为基础字符，仅在强度上加以区分。
